title: Palm Heroes 2 Deluxe
notes: Reviewed community evidence; not a complete playthrough verification.

reviewedUserReports.notes: ARM64 Release build on POCO X3 NFC (Android 12). Upright main menu; Single Player -> New Game -> Break reached adventure map. Tapping a road tile and horse moved the hero; enemy encounter opened tactical battle, and tapping a unit moved it on the grid. Emulator pause/resume returned to battle. Intro can be inverted. Battle completion, audio, saves, sustained play, other scenarios and widescreen were NOT verified. Partial, not full-game approval.
